ffmpeg.wasm (used by the online audio/video tools)
==================================================

@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 and @ffmpeg/util 0.12.2 (vendor/ffmpeg, vendor/ffmpeg-util)
  Licence: MIT - Copyright (c) 2019 Jerome Wu
  Source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (vendor/ffmpeg-core: ffmpeg-core.js, ffmpeg-core.wasm)
  FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly together with libx264, libvpx, LAME, libvorbis and other libraries.
  Licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (see GPL-2.0 text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html)
  Corresponding source code and build scripts:
    https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10   (build scripts, Dockerfile)
    https://ffmpeg.org/download.html                           (FFmpeg source)
  The files are distributed unmodified, exactly as published on npm (@ffmpeg/core@0.12.10). ffmpeg-core.wasm is
  stored as two halves (ffmpeg-core.wasm.part1 + .part2, because some web hosts limit file sizes); the browser
  joins them back into the identical original file.
